SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-29-2015 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RIVERA, BRANDIE RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT KIM, JOON YONG KIM, SUCK JOON ALLSTATE INSURANCE COMPANY(AGENT: CT CORP SYSTEM) $10,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $75.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $10,075.00, PLAINTIFF IS ENTITLED TO BE MADE "WHOLE" AND IS ENTITLED TO HAVE HER CASE RESTORED TO ITS PRE-ACCIDENT FAIR MARKET VALUE. THIS MEANS REPAIRING THE VEHICLE AND PAYING THE DIFFERENCE IN THE CAR'S RESALE VALUE BEFORE AND AFTER THE ACCIDENT. WHILE REPAIRS WERE MADE TO PLAINTIFF'S CAR, THE REPAIRS DID NOT RESTORE TO ITS PRE-ACCIDENT VALUE. PLAINTIFF IS THEREFORE ENTITLED TO THE DIMINISHED VALUE OF THE CARE I.E., THE DIFFERENCE IN THE FAIR MARKET VALUE BEFORE THE ACCIDENT AND AFTER IT WAS REPAIRED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED

SMALL CLAIMS APPEAL CALENDAR OF JAN-07-2016 - SMALL CLAIMS JUDGMENT REVERSED. THE JUDGMENT ON APPEAL IS FINAL AND REPLACES THE SMALL CLAIMS JUDGMENT OF OCT. 30, 2015. EXHIBITS WILL BE DESTROYED PURSUANT TO CCP 1952.

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT APPELLANT KIM, JOON YONG KIM, SUCK JOON TAKE NOTHING FROM RESPONDENT RIVERA, BRANDIE ALLSTATE INSURANCE COMPANY IS DISMISSED WITH PREJUDIE. JUDGMENT IS ORDERED IN FAVOR OF JOON YONG KIM AND SUCK JOON KIM AND AGAINST BRANDIE RIVERA IN THE AMOUNT OF $0.00. PLAINTIFF WAS PAID HER COSTS OF REPAIR, CACI3903. THIS JUDGMENT DOES NOT PREVENT PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM FOR ADDITIONAL REPAIRS CAUSED BY THE ACCIDENT. PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED NOTICE OF ENTRY OF JUDGMENT AND CERTIFICATE OF MAILING FILED
